results.name: Bombay Flying Club
results.evidence: The DGCA approved-FTO list includes The Bombay Flying Club, and the Government of India records it as a functional CPL flying-training organisation. It is a training provider rather than a university.
notes: Mapped to the existing dgca_fto family; this family is currently grouped under G8 in the database taxonomy.

results.name: Pearl Academy
results.evidence: Pearl Academy describes itself as a private design institution whose current bachelor's and master's degrees are offered through its CAES-RGNIYD arrangement; the academy itself is a private design school, not a separate university.
notes: Degrees under the RGNIYD arrangement should not be used to classify Pearl Academy as G3; parent/awarding-body linkage is a separate cleanup concern.

results.name: Symbiosis Institute of Design Pune
results.evidence: SID's official site identifies it as a constituent of Symbiosis International (Deemed University), and its mandatory disclosure cites Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956.
notes: Constituent-institute parent link to Symbiosis International should be added by the department/parent cleanup pass.

results.name: SP Jain Mumbai
results.evidence: SPJIMR's official AICTE disclosure lists its approved PGDM programmes and Category-I graded autonomy; it is a standalone management institute rather than a UGC university.

results.name: NCTE Recognised B.Ed Colleges
results.evidence: NCTE's official recognised-institutions service lists B.Ed institutions across multiple management types and affiliating universities.
notes: This is a mixed catalogue/category row, not one identifiable college; it cannot receive one institution_group without splitting it into actual institutions.

results.name: Coursera / edX MicroMasters
results.evidence: Coursera and edX provide online courses and professional/MicroMasters credentials from partner institutions; edX states that a MicroMasters credential is not itself a university admission or degree. This is an online learning-platform category, not a university.
notes: Keep awarding universities as separate providers; the platform row should not be treated as a degree-granting institution.

results.name: XLRI
results.evidence: XLRI's official release identifies its AICTE-approved PGDM programmes and describes XLRI as a business school founded by the Society of Jesus; it is not a UGC university.

results.name: Chennai Mathematical Institute
results.evidence: CMI's official 2026 brochure states that it was recognised as a university under Section 3 of the UGC Act in 2006 and directly awards B.S., M.Sc. and Ph.D. degrees.

results.name: Amity University (Actuarial Science)
results.evidence: Amity's official course page identifies the Noida B.Sc. Actuarial Science programme as a programme of Amity University Uttar Pradesh; the record is a programme-specific legacy row whose parent is the UGC-listed state private university.
notes: Parent-institute linking should point this programme row to Amity University Uttar Pradesh.

results.name: Bishop Heber College
results.evidence: Bishop Heber's official institutional profile identifies it as an autonomous institution affiliated to Bharathidasan University, with aided and self-financed programmes; its official site records UGC/AICTE approval and NAAC accreditation.
notes: The college has both aided and self-financed streams; govt_aided reflects its aided/autonomous institutional classification, not state ownership.
